name: WdOMathBreakSub
description: Specifies how Microsoft Word handles a subtraction operator that falls before a line break.

constants.name: wdOMathBreakSubMinusMinus
constants.description: Repeats a minus sign that ends before a line break at the beginning of the next line. Default.

constants.name: wdOMathBreakSubPlusMinus
constants.description: Inserts a plus sign at the end of the first line, before the line break, and a minus sign at the beginning of the following line, before the number.

constants.name: wdOMathBreakSubMinusPlus
constants.description: Inserts a minus sign at the end of the first line, before the line break, and a plus sign at the beginning of the following line, before the number.
